text: The `typer 0.24.1` side of the graph resolves to `annotated-doc 0.0.4`, `click 8.3.1`, `rich 14.3.3`, and `shellingham 1.5.4`; `click` conditionally depends on `colorama 0.4.6` for `sys_platform == 'win32'`, `rich` depends on `markdown-it-py 4.0.0` and `pygments 2.19.2`, and `markdown-it-py` depends on `mdurl 0.1.2`.
